venue.name: [Mathematical Grammar School](https://www.mg.edu.rs)
venue.details: Pratite znakove da dođete do hale. / Follow the signs to the venue.

items.information: Serbian Open 2019 je speedcubing takmičenje. Svako moze da se takmiči, nezavisno od njihove nacionalnosti ili godina, ali moraju biti upoznati sa WCA Regulacijama. Ovo takmičenje je priznato i kao Srpsko Nacionalno Prvenstvo. ------------------------ Serbian Open 2019 is a speedcubing competition. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations. This competition is also recognized as a Serbian National Championship.

items.information: ## Takmičenje je otkazano radi sprečavanja širenja Korona virusa (COVID-19). (SRB) Serbian Championship 2020 je osmo po redu takmičenje koje se održava u Srbiji. Svako može da se takmiči, nezavisno od njihove nacionalnosti ili godina, ali moraju biti upoznati sa WCA Regulacijama i moraju da ih pročitaju pre takmičenja. (ENG) Serbian Championship 2020 is the 8th speedcubing competition in a row that's being held in Serbia. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations and read them before the competition. This competition is also recognized as a Serbian National Championship.

items.name: Serbian FMC Championship 2025

venue.name: [Montessori Primary School](https://montesori.edu.rs/)
venue.details: Second floor of the school building / Drugi sprat kuće

items.information: (SRB) Serbian FMC Championship 2025 je dvadeset i peto po redu takmičenje koje se održava u Srbiji. Svako može da se takmiči, nezavisno od njihove nacionalnosti ili godina, ali moraju biti upoznati sa WCA Regulacijama i moraju da ih pročitaju pre takmičenja. **Na ovom takmičenju se održava isključivo FMC disciplina i priznato je kao srpsko državno prvenstvo!** Za ostale discipline pogledajte takmičenje [Serbian Championship 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SerbianChampionship2025). (ENG) Serbian FMC Championship 2025 is the 25th speedcubing competition in a row that's being held in Serbia. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations and read them before the competition. **This competition will hold FMC as the only event and is recognized as Serbian Championship 2025!** For other events check competition [Serbian Championship 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SerbianChampionship2025).
